[object]

replacement [required]

string

The redacted replacement content.

scfw_findings

object

The Supply Chain Firewall verdict for the version-pinned install packages found in the request. Evaluation requires Supply Chain Firewall to be enabled for the organization and the caller to have the appsec_vm_read permission. Without that permission, Supply Chain Firewall evaluation is skipped; the AI Guard evaluation request itself is not rejected. Findings are omitted when Supply Chain Firewall does not produce a result. The recommended action combines the package outcomes. Confirmation support is inferred from the evaluator profile, not from a separate confirmation-capability flag. By default, a non-empty meta.coding_agent selects the coding-agent profile, which assumes the caller can ask for confirmation and retains WARN in recommended_action. Omitting meta.coding_agent or setting it to an empty string selects the default profile, which assumes the caller cannot ask for confirmation and returns ALLOW instead of WARN in recommended_action. Package outcomes still retain WARN, and BLOCK is never changed to ALLOW by this rule.

The package ecosystem the firewall evaluated, such as PyPI, npm, or crates.io.

request.html:
data [required]

object

The JSON:API request envelope for an AI Guard evaluation.

attributes [required]

object

The conversation to evaluate and its metadata.

messages [required]

[object]

The messages of the conversation to evaluate, in order. Must contain at least one message.

content

 <oneOf>

The content of a message, either a plain string or a list of OpenAI-style content parts.

Object 1

string

The message content as a plain string.

Object 2

[object]

The message content as a list of content parts. The list must be non-empty for user, system, developer, and tool messages.

image_url

object

An image referenced by URL in a message content part.

url [required]

string

The image URL or a data URI with an image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, or image/webp MIME type.

text

string

The text content, required and non-empty when type is text in a user, system, developer, or tool message.

type [required]

enum

The type of the content part. Allowed enum values: text,image_url

role [required]

enum

The role of the message author in the conversation. Allowed enum values: user,assistant,system,developer,tool

tool_call_id

string

The identifier of the tool call this message responds to, present on tool result messages.

tool_calls

[object]

The tool calls emitted by the assistant, present on assistant messages that call tools.

function [required]

object

The function invoked by a tool call.

arguments [required]

string

The arguments of the function call, serialized as a JSON string.

name [required]

string

The name of the function to call.

id [required]

string

The identifier of the tool call.

meta

object

Metadata about the evaluated conversation, used to select the policy and evaluator behavior.

coding_agent

string

The coding agent that produced the conversation. By default, a non-empty value selects the coding-agent evaluator profile, while an omitted or empty value selects the default profile. Known identifiers include claude-code, codex, cursor, and github-copilot; other identifiers are accepted. The coding-agent profile assumes the caller can ask the user to confirm Supply Chain Firewall warnings; the default profile assumes it cannot.

confidence_threshold

 <oneOf>

Request-only confidence threshold override. A number sets the threshold for every threat category; an object supplies a global threshold and optional per-category overrides. Omit this field to use the stored sensitivity policy. This field is not returned in evaluation responses.

Object 1

double

The global confidence threshold applied to every threat category.

Object 2

object

Request-level confidence threshold override. flagging_global is the global threshold applied to every threat category. Any other property is a per-category override keyed by an AI Guard threat tag; per-category values take precedence over flagging_global, and categories without an entry fall back to it. When this object omits flagging_global, the fallback is 0.5. Recognized category keys include policy-evasion, indirect-prompt-injection, system-and-capability-discovery, credential-access, sensitive-data-collection, privilege-escalation, malicious-execution, private-network-target, destructive-or-resource-abuse, tool-abuse, poisoning-or-persistence, and data-exfiltration. Unknown category keys are ignored.

flagging_global

double

The global confidence threshold applied to categories without a specific override.

env

string

The environment the conversation belongs to.

is_sds_enabled_override

boolean

Whether to run the Sensitive Data Scanner for this request, overriding the stored policy.

service

string

The name of the service the conversation belongs to.

tool_policies

object

A non-empty map replaces stored tool policies for this request only, keyed by tool name. Any called tool not present resolves to EVALUATE. Only takes effect when tool policies are enabled for the organization.

<any-key>

enum

The policy action for a tool named by the property. Tool policies override the recommendation after evaluation; they do not skip evaluation. Any BLOCK takes precedence over PASS and EVALUATE. The Supply Chain Firewall is applied afterward and can still return DENY. Allowed enum values: PASS,BLOCK,EVALUATE

type [required]

enum

The JSON:API resource type for AI Guard evaluation requests and responses. Its value is evaluations for the action endpoint /api/v2/ai-guard/evaluate. Allowed enum values: evaluations
